questions.subject: INTEGRATED_2
questions.topic: Conditional probability from a two-way table
questions.stem: In a marine biologist's tank, 60 fish: 30 red, 12 of which are large; P(red | large) if 20 large total?
questions.explanation: P(red|large)=12/20=0.6. A common slip is to use 12/30=0.4, conditioning on red instead.

questions.stem: In a marine biologist's tank, tree: P(A)=0.4, P(B|A)=0.5; find P(A and B).
